_about: Card upgrade and Forge costs, 2026-10-23 (package HUB2, owner 11:11: "For all these upgrade costs and forge costs, put them in the master hub and let them be editable."). Moved here from constants in arena_app.js with the same values. The game build (assemble_arena.py, into arena_app.js UPGRADE_COSTS) bakes this file in; the master hub's Costs tab (tools/hub/upgrade_costs_tab.js) edits it, edits fold back with tools/fold_upgrade_costs.js (tools/hub/pull_upgrade_costs.md). Level road: the Dust of one step L -> L+1 on a Common is forgeStepDust[L] (x levelCostMult of the card), its Leaves (gold) two thirds of that; the first step (Level 0 -> 1) is one Materia Mote = materiaUnit / moteDivisor. A limit break (10 -> 11) costs limitBreakCostMult times the whole road to 10. levelCostMult is per rarity; hero cards also x modifiers.hero, event cards x modifiers.event, quest and map-reward cards x modifiers.questBase; Base cards (owned from the start: source Base, starters, tutorial and basic cards) x modifiers.base (1, BAL2 2026-10-24, DF-2: full cost; they stop at Lv 4). The Forge tiers' gold/dust/strange/map can also be overridden live by the admin editor (card_overrides __cfg:forge-tiers); fold those in here too, then clear them. materiaSocket (H1 2026-10-24, owner decision H1: Unique and rarer cards have one Materia gem socket per copy): per rank, the Dust and Leaves (gold) to set a gem (apply) and to take it out (remove); placeholder values. A flagged rarity (Quest-Unique, Dev-Legendary ...) pays its rank's. bramble (ECON1 2026-10-30, owner BRUP-1: "Their own resource & a bit of normal resource"): a bramble's Reinforce step costs blossomsPerDust x the step's Dust in Briar Blossoms, plus normalShare of the step's Dust and Leaves (the step itself is castleLevelUpCost's ramp in arena_app.js: (15 + 12L) Dust and (10 + 8L) Leaves x the bramble's rarity multiplier, x3 for levels 10-19).
